hypothesis: Authenticated complete step traces can reach the existing RVL optimizer through CapabilityLoop without regeneration, reward substitution, partial-group training or ambiguous automatic redelivery.
cheaper_gate: Source-level ingestion, ownership, cancellation and recovery regressions; no semantic base-model screen is attempted.
scope: Systems correctness with real neural weights, synthetic checksum training rewards and a separate checksum diagnostic grader. Neither grader establishes task success. Stage D semantic task/evaluator qualification remains NO-GO.
workload: Pure lookup tool observation, then actual model inference conditioned on the shared observation; terminal action only receives trajectory reward. Fresh seed/round task IDs and disjoint fixed audit prompt IDs.
device: CPU fp32, one Torch thread, 2 execute workers and 1 verifier; bounded backlog16 and replay4.
objective: RVL token-mean PPO-clipped group-relative objective, epsilon 1e-6; AdamW lr 1e-4 with historical default decay 0.01
reference: Reuse PR71 full-graph equation, not a new trainer; numerical tolerances fixed from the already justified fp32 contract.
independent_evaluation: Disjoint fresh diagnostic prompts; reload actual checkpoint into a separate model object and greedy-decode without RVL generation/optimizer/reward callback; signed checkpoint-bound reports.
promotion: Diagnostic ties allowed at rounds0,2,3; round1 requires impossible gain1.1 and must reject with exact incumbent restoration. No capability promotion claim.
fault: Round2 interrupts ingestion acknowledgment after the existing model transaction. Exact model/optimizer/RNG/step reload, new ingestion owner, quarantine uncertain delivery, then actual subsequent round3 update. Same-process logical restart; no new learner SIGKILL claim.
acceptance: Exactly four actual optimizer calls and changed model tensors per seed; numerical agreement; independent decoder agreement; forced reject; durable unresolved delivery survives ACK loss; exact recovery followed by another update; clean final journals and streamed audit.
budget: 3 sequential CPU cases, maximum1200s and8GiB RSS per case; no API/GPU/paid services.
abort: First failed correctness/numerical/state condition stops the case; preserve failure and do not resample. Corrected systems runners require separately versioned outputs/protocol after observation.
decision: Keep the minimal ingestion adapter only if existing transaction boundaries and recovery are preserved. Do not start a new capability study.
supersedes: V1/V2 retained. Re-review exposed unnecessary recovery fences on failed pre-reservation budget checks and cancelled idle polls. V3 preserves ownership only for actually reserved or uncertain delivery. Normal update objectives, budgets, tolerances and acceptance remain unchanged; fresh diagnostic seeds.
